import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
DATA_PATH = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_PATH}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_PATH}/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_PATH}/sample_submission.csv")

# Get species columns and create mapping from sample submission
species_columns = list(sample_sub.columns[1:])
print(f"Species columns count: {len(species_columns)}")

species_name_to_idx = {col: i for i, col in enumerate(species_columns)}
idx_to_species = {i: col for i, col in enumerate(species_columns)}

# Prepare target encoding for training data
species = train_df["species"].tolist()
train_species_encoded = train_df["species"].map(species_name_to_idx).values

# Extract feature matrices - all columns except id and species
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
X_test_id = test_df["id"].values

# Split data for validation - keep separate for genuine evaluation
X_train_split, X_val, y_train_idx, y_val_idx = train_test_split(
    X_train,
    train_species_encoded,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_species_encoded,
)

# Initialize LightGBM classifier with tuned parameters for better generalization
clf = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.03,
    num_leaves=31,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
    force_col_wise=False,
    cat_boost=False,
)

# Train with early stopping based on validation loss
best_val_score = float("inf")
best_iter = 0
for epoch in range(100):
    clf.fit(
        X_train_split,
        y_train_idx,
        eval_set=[(X_val, y_val_idx)],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
    )

    # Get current validation log-loss
    val_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_val)
    val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val_idx, val_proba)

    if val_log_loss < best_val_score:
        best_val_score = val_log_loss
        best_iter = clf.best_iteration

    if val_log_loss > 0.7 and epoch % 2 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch}, Val Log-Loss: {val_log_loss:.6f}")

# Use final best trained model
clf_final = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=best_iter + 100,  # Add buffer after early stopping
    learning_rate=0.03,
    num_leaves=31,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
)
clf_final.fit(X_train_split, y_train_idx)

# Predict probabilities on validation set and compute log-loss properly
val_proba = clf_final.predict_proba(X_val)
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val_idx, val_proba)  # Uses natural log by default
print(f"Hold-out validation log-loss: {val_log_loss:.6f}")

# Final training with full budget
final_clf = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=800,
    learning_rate=0.03,
    num_leaves=31,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
)
final_clf.fit(X_train_split, y_train_idx)

# Predictions on full test set (this is what gets submitted)
test_proba = final_clf.predict_proba(X_test)

# Normalize probabilities to match submission requirements
row_sums = test_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_proba_norm = test_proba / (row_sums + 1e-15)

# Clamp probabilities to avoid extremes
clamped_proba = np.clip(test_proba_norm, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Build submission dataframe using exact column order from sample
submission_ids = X_test_id

# Create final submission dataframe
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": submission_ids,
        **{col: clamped_proba[:, idx] for idx, col in enumerate(species_columns)},
    }
)

# Save submission to correct location
submission_path = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

# Print evaluation metric
print(f"Final Multi-class Log-Loss on Validation Set: {val_log_loss:.6f}")
